calculation.description: Cross-sectional residual 20-session return, risk scaled by 40-session residual volatility, with the sign reversed when 20- and 60-session residual trends agree. Lagged one session before evaluation to prevent look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Strong aggregate negative persistence/trend-quality relationship across 2024-2033; sign-reversed contrarian formulation passes absolute daily paper IC and ICIR gates. Regime ICs: 2024-26 0.145653, 2027-29 0.018641, 2030-32 0.053599, 2032-33 0.070266. Small 15-asset universe requires conservative sizing and ongoing revalidation.
